caseName: Bell v. Itawamba Cnty. Sch. Bd.
caseNameFull: Taylor BELL v. ITAWAMBA COUNTY SCHOOL BOARD

opinions.text: Motion of The Student Press Law Center, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Massachusetts Citizens for Children for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.
